structured.answer: I'd open the account at Pesagot and buy the "אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)" fund, and the page says I'd end up with about 86,045 ₪ after 10 years. That's on the page's default of 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month, though, not my 30,000, and I didn't try to change the fields.

stuck.why: It says 10,000, not my 30,000. In these screenshots I can't type in it, so every number I saw is for someone else's amount.
It took me a second to get that 'זוג' means an account plus a fund together, and that −1,030 ₪ means the next pair leaves you with less.
Fifteen banks look alike and I was about to give up. I stopped because Pesagot was on top, highlighted, with 'הזול'.
The starting point is Harel + Jerusalem at 79,910 ₪, and that confused me for a moment, since I thought I'd already picked Pesagot.

findings.what: Every account row repeats the same 'לא בחישוב מחיר אחר ל...' tag and the same yellow/orange bar, so I had to reread each one to spot the difference
The fee colours are explained only once, in a legend higher up, so the bars further down are a guess
findings.where: screens 3 and 7 legend vs bars on 4–6

findings.what: Minus signs on the fund returns (−0.04%, −0.37%) look like losses and scared me, even on the recommended fund
The amount is a default 10,000, not mine, so the big number 86,045 isn't really my number
The waterfall starts from Harel/Jerusalem instead of my choice, which confused me
The fund's fee is shown as a small % (0.1%, נאמן 0.025%), while the account fee is in shekels, so they're hard to compare
Lots of underlined numbers that look clickable, with no idea what tapping them does
